name: AfterSell
summary: Post-purchase upsell and cross-sell app for Shopify (by Rokt): one-click upsells, downsells and thank-you-page offers plus checkout customization to lift average order value — no extra ad spend.
best_for: Shopify stores with steady order volume that want to lift average order value with one-click post-purchase and checkout upsells
skip_if: your store gets only a trickle of orders — fix traffic and conversion first; there's nothing to upsell against low volume
honest_knock: Post-purchase upsells only move the needle with steady order volume and a sensible complementary-offer strategy — bolt it onto a store with little traffic and there's nothing to upsell. The no-rev-share model is a genuine plus over percentage-based rivals.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: Three plans, each metered by monthly order volume, read on aftersell.com/pricing and on the Shopify App Store listing on 22 September 2026 (re-verified 22 September 2026 and again 27 September 2026). The entry prices: Post-Purchase $34.99 a month for 200 monthly orders, capped at $999.99; Pre-Purchase $59.99 for 200, capped at $599.99; Complete $79.99, capped at $1,359.99 - and on 27 September 2026 the Complete card quotes that $79.99 for 500 monthly orders, where on 22 September it read 200 like the other two. The page does not say whether the Complete entry tier was widened or the card is wrong, so confirm the tier for your own volume in the app before you install. Complete is the other two together, which the vendor prices at 15% under buying them separately. Go over a volume tier and the fee steps up to the matching one on its own, with that cap as the ceiling. Every plan carries a 30-day free trial, all charges are billed in USD, and the Free plan on the listing is for development and partner stores only. Checkout upsells are Shopify Plus only and now sit inside Post-Purchase and Complete rather than being billed separately. Rokt Thanks, the third-party offers on the confirmation page, is free with no minimum order volume and pays up to $0.80 per order; for stores above 1,000 monthly orders whose primary market is the US, Canada, Australia or the UK those earnings are credited against the subscription dollar for dollar. Aftersell Max, for high-volume stores, is custom-priced and publishes no figure. The unexplained $19.99 we saw above the $79.99 on the Complete card on 22 September 2026 is no longer on the page on 27 September. This replaces the single order-volume ladder we recorded on 5 September 2026 ($34.99 for 0-500 orders, $54.99 for 501-1,000, $99.99 for 1,001-2,000); that ladder is on neither page any more.
